name: navigator
description: Routes a legal task to exactly one of the 24 Rohas Legal AI plugins and creates a context-aware, ready-to-paste prompt for that plugin.

interface.longDescription: A closed-world router for the 24 Rohas Legal AI practice plugins. It identifies the single best plugin for the user's intended legal outcome and produces a complete prompt that preserves available project, document, and evidence context.
defaultPrompt: Which Rohas Legal AI plugin should I use to review this agreement, and what should I ask it?
I need help with this legal task. Choose the right Rohas plugin and write the prompt for me.
Turn my objective into a prompt for the correct Rohas Legal AI plugin.
